sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement Ornith-1.5 takes a major step toward building foundation models through end-to-end self-improvement, extending the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts. sources.title: ornith-1.5 - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Rather than relying on a fixed set of human-curated tasks and manually designed harnesses, Ornith-1.5 continuously generates new training tasks, discovers effective strategies for solving them, and improves the policy through reinforcement learning. For more details on the task, harness, and rollout reward design, please refer to our blog.
